: UBS Group AG TEMP (UBSG) doubled its debt tender cap, raising the maximum buyback from €2 billion to €4 billion, expanding the program and increasing potential debt repurchases.
: UBS Group (UBSG) will end fund sales via its Shenzhen China distribution unit at end of September; other China wealth platforms stay active as UBS plans to consolidate China resources.
